training: Refit the unchanged linear raw-path models on valid LOW_VOL-L rows with decision_time before 2025-01-01 and exit_time at or before 2025-01-01.
overlap_weight: Unchanged clipped absolute Strong-R weight divided by the number of same-sleeve decisions in the same 30-minute bucket.

reference_distribution.source: Complete 2024 LOW_VOL-L out-of-sample raw predictions from the frozen 2023 V4 models.
reference_distribution.component_percentiles: Each 2025 component prediction is ranked against the corresponding 2024 raw prediction distribution.
reference_distribution.score: mean of probability, Strong-R and Extreme-R percentiles minus one standard deviation of those three percentiles.
reference_distribution.threshold: 99th percentile of the 2024 reference score distribution, preserving the frozen one-percent retention fraction.

failure_policy: Reject without 2026 rescue or threshold change.
